description: This file defines the WidgetContextCacheKey class, which provides a way to generate cache keys based on widget context maps, especially used within the Apache OFBiz framework's widget caching mechanism. It includes logic for equality checking and string representation of cache keys, while skipping certain fields during comparison.

classes.name: WidgetContextCacheKey
classes.description: Represents a cache key based on a widget context map, with custom equality and string representation logic that skips certain context fields.

methods.name: WidgetContextCacheKey
methods.description: Constructor that takes a context map and stores an unmodifiable copy.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a constant hash code (not recommended for production, likely for use in scenarios where only equals is used for comparison).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two WidgetContextCacheKey objects by comparing their context maps, skipping certain fields and handling nested 'parameters' fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the cache key, filtering out fields to exclude from display.
